    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    # Combine all potential targets with a priority order: resources, enemies, border
    targets = resources or enemies or border

    if targets:
        # Find the closest target
        target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-position[0]) + abs(t[1]-position[1]))
        dx = (target[0] - position[0])
        dy = (target[1] - position[1])
        # Normalize to -1, 0, or 1
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Default move: avoid stagnation, try to explore or escape
        # For robustness, pick a random direction with priority to open space
        # Since no environment info, default to move right unless blocked
        # To ensure deterministic behavior, choose upward movement
